issue.title: Requirement close Undo refuses after project frontmatter refresh
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:**  (guarded requirement Undo)

After a Carry or Carry+pull-in in a project note, Bob Project Tasks refreshes  /  frontmatter after autosave. The receipt's guarded Undo compares the whole note and refuses with , even though only frontmatter changed.

Reproduction: close a project task with Pending requirements, choose Carry, wait for the project count frontmatter refresh, then click Undo.

The requirement writes remain in the note and require manual cleanup. Investigate a guarded Undo that survives unrelated frontmatter changes while preserving protection against edits to the requirement and carried-task writes.

Reproduction: close a project task with Pending requirements, choose Carry, wait for the project count frontmatter refresh, then click Undo.

The requirement writes remain in the note and require manual cleanup. Investigate a guarded Undo that survives unrelated frontmatter changes while preserving protection against edits to the requirement and carried-task writes.
